newsitem.title: USA: US Mid-Atlantic next-day power drops on mild temps.
newsitem.headline: US Mid-Atlantic next-day power drops on mild temps.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the Mid-Atlantic U.S. for Monday delivery tumbled from Thursday's level on outlook of weather moderating from the current cold spell.
But frigid weather was expected to linger at least through Saturday before relief would be in sight.
"It's supposed to be pretty darn cold tomorrow," said a Mid-Atlantic trader.
For Saturday, the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnect (PJM) district was forecast to receive peak temperatures in 40s Fahrenheit and off-peak temperatures in the teens to 20s.
Today's hourly generating rate in the PJM pool hit a high of $42.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), evenly matched with the daily peak rates this week, market sources said.
Another rally in natural gas prices in the U.S. Gulf failed to lift daily PJM power prices for a second day.
"The play in gas has been less the last couple of days," a PJM broker said.
NYMEX December Henry Hub natural gas futures rose 8.3 cents to $2.865 per million British thermal units.
Swing natgas deliveries to the Philadelphia city gate were valued today in the $3.50-$3.60 range, up from mid-week's $3.40 area.

Firm, peak electricity scheduled for Saturday was assessed at $24.00-$26.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), Sunday $22.00-$23.00 and Monday $23.00-$24.00, sharply lower than $28.00-$29.00 on Thursday for Friday delivery.
Firm, off-peak PJM power for Saturday was valued near $20.00, Sunday and Monday near $17.00, compared with Thursday's range of $16.00-$18.00.
December PJM deliveries were pegged at $28.35-$28.60, compared with $28.35-$28.50 on Thursday.
"It's not moving in big amounts. December's going sideway," said a marketer in Houston.
January/February 1997 PJM electricity was assessed at $32.35-$32.50, better offered than Thursday's $32.35-$32.60.
March 1997 PJM power was valued at $24.40-$24.80, a slightly wider range than Thursday's $24.50-$24.75.
Second-quarter 1997 PJM electricity was discussed at $22.10-$22.50. July/August 1997 PJM power was $31.50-$32.00.
PJM power deliveries for the entire 1997 period was heard done at $26.00 and $26.20, compared with Thursday's range of $25.95-$26.15.
